summary_en: Try the wheel for an hour in a working studio on the Pottery Footpath.
description_en: A fictional studio to demonstrate experience listings. Short wheel sessions are taught with plenty of gestures and a little English, and you choose a glaze for your piece at the end.
Finished pottery needs to be fired, so ask about overseas shipping if you won't be back in town.
access_en: About 10 minutes on foot, up the hill along the Pottery Footpath.
